name: Jakmai
title: Descendants of Nahor
summary: Jakmai is a person mentioned in 1 Chronicles as one of the descendants in Israel's genealogy. He is the son of Shemida from the tribe of Manasseh. Although little is known about his personal life, he is part of the genealogical framework that connects the tribes of Israel.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in Manasseh's genealogy
keyEvents.description: Jakmai is listed as one of the sons of Shemida, who belonged to the tribe of Manasseh, in the genealogy of 1 Chronicles.

keyEvents.title: Part of the Tribe of Manasseh
keyEvents.description: Jakmai belonged to the tribe of Manasseh, one of the twelve tribes of Israel, which played an important role in Israel's history and land distribution.

keyEvents.title: The sons of Shemida listed
keyEvents.description: Shemida's four sons, including Jakmai, Akjan, Shechem and Likhi, are mentioned as part of the detailed genealogy of the people of Israel.

keyEvents.title: The Genealogies in Chronicles
keyEvents.description: The genealogical records in Chronicles served to preserve Israel's tribal identity and inheritance rights, and Jakmai is part of this important historical document.
